items.q: AB is parallel to CD. Work out the size of the angle marked y.
items.imageAlt: Parallel lines AB and CD cut by a transversal, with a 60 degree marked angle on the right and angle y on the left.
items.imageCaption: Original diagram image stored beside its topic file.
hints: Use the parallel-line angle facts (alternate, corresponding, or co-interior) to relate y to the marked 60° angle.
y and the 60° angle are equal by one of the parallel-line angle rules shown in the diagram.

items.q: Co-interior angles on parallel lines are x and 115°. Find x.
hints: Co-interior (allied) angles on parallel lines sum to 180°.

items.q: Alternate angles on parallel lines are x and 47°. Find x.
hints: Alternate angles on parallel lines are equal.

items.q: A straight-line angle is split into x and 132°. Find x.
hints: Angles on a straight line sum to 180°.

items.q: A vertically opposite angle to 83° is x. Find x.
hints: Vertically opposite angles are equal.

items.q: Corresponding angles are 3x and 96°. Find x.
hints: Corresponding angles on parallel lines are equal.

items.q: Find the sum of the interior angles of a pentagon.
hints: Use the formula: sum of interior angles = (n - 2) x 180°, where n is the number of sides.

items.q: Find the sum of the interior angles of an octagon.
hints: Use the formula: sum of interior angles = (n - 2) x 180°, where n is the number of sides.

items.q: Each interior angle of a regular hexagon is x. Find x.
hints: Find the total interior angle sum, then divide by the number of sides.

items.q: A quadrilateral has angles 90°, 88°, 101°, and x. Find x.
hints: The interior angles of a quadrilateral sum to 360°.

items.q: A pentagon has interior angles summing to how many degrees?
hints: Use the formula: sum of interior angles = (n - 2) x 180°, where n is the number of sides.

items.q: Find one exterior angle of a regular nonagon.
hints: The exterior angles of any regular polygon sum to 360° — divide by the number of sides.

items.q: Find one exterior angle of a regular decagon.
hints: The exterior angles of any regular polygon sum to 360° — divide by the number of sides.

items.q: A regular polygon has exterior angle 45°. How many sides does it have?
hints: The exterior angles sum to 360° — divide 360 by the given exterior angle to find the number of sides.

items.q: Find one interior angle of a regular pentagon.
hints: Find the exterior angle first (360° / n), then subtract from 180°.
Exterior angle = 360/5 = 72, so interior = 180 - 72.

items.q: A regular polygon has 12 sides. Find one exterior angle.
hints: The exterior angles of any regular polygon sum to 360° — divide by the number of sides.

items.q: A regular polygon has exterior angle 24°. How many sides does it have?
hints: The exterior angles sum to 360° — divide 360 by the given exterior angle to find the number of sides.

items.q: Find one interior angle of a regular octagon.
hints: Find the exterior angle first (360° / n), then subtract from 180°.
Exterior angle = 360/8 = 45, so interior = 180 - 45.
